name: investor-whiteboard
description: Explains a company to an investor by drawing it live on a whiteboard in the browser: six flowchart maps (business, money flow, supply chain, technology, competition, thesis), each with a step-by-step walk-through in plain words, and a memory of how the investor likes things explained.

interface.shortDescription: Companies explained as live flowchart maps
interface.longDescription: Name a company and Codex draws it on a whiteboard in your browser while it works: what the business sells and to whom, where the money comes from and goes, the supply chain, the technology, the rivals, and the case for and against. Every map has a step-by-step walk-through in plain words. It remembers how you like things explained, and shares that memory with Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Explain this company on the whiteboard
Walk me through how this company makes money
